sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- Despite being unfoldable in-game, this stock can be folded in real life.
- The "ZHUKOV" text used on both sides of the stock is incorrect.
  - The text used on the left of the stock is in reverse and is supposed to say "MAGPUL".
  - The text on right of the stock is supposed to say "ZHUKOV-S".
